# Contributing

Thanks for helping. Building, testing, the design docs and how changes land are all in [`docs/developer.md`](../docs/developer.md).

In short: branch off `main`, keep commits small with plain-sentence subjects, open a PR that says what you tested, and expect a review before it merges. For anything larger than a fix, open an issue or a discussion first so we can agree on the shape.

Please report security problems privately; see [`SECURITY.md`](../SECURITY.md).
